newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's king meets freed Hamas leader.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's king meets freed Hamas leader.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein on Tuesday met Musa Abu Marzook, political leader of the Palestinian Islamic Resistance Movement Hamas, a week after his release from a New York jail, the state news agency Petra said.
Abu Marzook thanked King Hussein for "his efforts with the U.S. adminstration in securing his release and allowing him back in Jordan," Petra said.

Abu Marzook, accused by Israel of responsibility for a wave of attacks in which scores of Israelis died, was arrested in New York a few weeks after his expulsion from Jordan in 1995. He was jailed while Israel sought his extradition but never charged.

King Hussein agreed to allow Abu Marzook to return "without any obligations" other than abiding by Jordanian law under a deal worked out with the U.S. authorities who deported him after Israel dropped its extradition request on security grounds.
Abu Marzook, a stateless Palestinian who was born in Gaza in 1951, arrived last week to settle in Amman.
